title: Introducing Codex
attributed_claim_summary: OpenAI launched a cloud-based coding agent designed to carry out multiple software engineering tasks in parallel.
evidence_or_event: Source-authored report or launch; no original measurements collected in this repository.
limitations: The original launch article explicitly notes that it is outdated; launch capability does not imply safe production operation.
research_relevance: AI-era coding workflow -> secure functionality -> independent reuse -> lifetime cost; distinguish release availability from observed adoption.
practical_experiment: Compare parallel-agent branches against serial workflows on accepted tasks and total review/rework cost.
